notes: Fixed: TalkBack's two-finger double-tap now plays and pauses Tarang - it never did. Tarang refused every playback controller that wasn't the app itself or its own notification, which sounds cautious but also turned away the system, and the system is what carries a media key from TalkBack, a Bluetooth headset button, a car head unit or the Assistant; anything the platform itself vouches for is accepted now, while an ordinary third-party app still is not. Fixed: Settings switches that are turned off by something else now say so - a greyed-out switch was announced as an ordinary working one, so the only clue it could not be changed was that nothing happened when you tapped it. Fixed: chapter rows in the YouTube player didn't say they were tappable - TalkBack read the chapter out as plain text with no hint that double-tapping jumps there, and it now announces "Play from 12:04" the way every other tappable row in the app does. Fixed: "Show description" was a 20-pixel-tall tap target, under half the minimum size, which is hardest on exactly the people most likely to be tapping by feel after a screen reader announces it; it is a full-size target now and announces whether the description is open or closed. Fixed: recent searches announced a bare word - the little clock icon is what tells a sighted user those chips are things you searched before, while a screen reader just got "bbc", and they now read "Recent search: bbc". Fixed: search suggestions were reachable but unlabelled, and the whole suggestion list was marked as a heading, so jumping by heading landed on a scroll container that isn't a label for anything; the list is no longer a heading and each suggestion says what tapping it does. New: Radio has a country filter - Pakistan's stations were added to the catalogue last release but nothing in the app could ask for them because Radio was hard-wired to India; country now sits at the top of the Filters sheet and picking one rebuilds the language, state and category chips around it, India stays the default so nothing changes for anyone who never opens the filter, and Sports is still worldwide on purpose. New: search falls back to a worldwide directory - when a search finds nothing in Tarang's own list it looks the name up in RadioBrowser's public directory of around 50,000 stations and shows what it has, clearly labelled as not being from Tarang's own list and not liveness-checked; it only ever runs on a search that already came back empty, never to fill Trending, the chips, or any browsable list, and Settings > Radio > "Search the global directory" turns it off, which keeps what you type from leaving the app.
